53 function channelEnabled(channel) {
54 if (channel === 1) {
55 return ch1Enabled
56 }
57 if (channel === 2) {
58 return ch2Enabled
59 }
60 if (channel === 3) {
61 return ch3Enabled
62 }
63 if (channel === 4) {
64 return ch4Enabled
65 }
66 return false
67 }

69 function filteredSeries(rawSeries) {
70 var list = rawSeries || []
71 var out = []
72 for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
73 var series = list[i]
74 if (channelEnabled(Number(series.channel))) {
75 out.push(series)
76 }
77 }
78 return out
79 }
80
81 function _statsObject(seriesList) {
82 var totalCount = 0
83 var minV = 0
84 var maxV = 0
85 var sumV = 0
86 var found = false
87 var lastY = 0
88 var lastX = -1e100
89
90 for (var i = 0; i < seriesList.length; i++) {
91 var points = seriesList[i].points || []
92 for (var j = 0; j < points.length; j++) {
93 var x = Number(points[j].x)
94 var y = Number(points[j].y)
95 if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) {
96 continue
97 }
98
99 if (!found) {
100 minV = y
101 maxV = y
102 found = true
103 } else {
104 if (y < minV) {
105 minV = y
106 }
107 if (y > maxV) {
108 maxV = y
109 }
110 }
111 if (x >= lastX) {
112 lastX = x
113 lastY = y
114 }
115 sumV += y
116 totalCount += 1
117 }
118 }
119
120 if (!found || totalCount <= 0) {
121 return {"count": 0, "min": 0, "max": 0, "avg": 0, "last": 0}
122 }
123
124 return {
125 "count": totalCount,
126 "min": minV,
127 "max": maxV,
128 "avg": sumV / totalCount,
129 "last": lastY
130 }
131 }
132
133 function _formatValue(value, decimals) {
134 if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
135 return "--"
136 }
137 var d = Math.max(0, Number(decimals))
138 if (Math.abs(value) > 0 && Math.abs(value) < 1e-3) {
139 return value.toExponential(2)
140 }
141 return value.toFixed(d)
142 }
143
144 function statsSummary(seriesList, unit, decimals) {
145 var stats = _statsObject(seriesList)
146 if (stats.count <= 0) {
147 return "No data"
148 }
149 return "n=" + stats.count
150 + " | min " + _formatValue(stats.min, decimals) + unit
151 + " | max " + _formatValue(stats.max, decimals) + unit
152 + " | avg " + _formatValue(stats.avg, decimals) + unit
153 + " | last " + _formatValue(stats.last, decimals) + unit
154 }

156 function activeChannelsText() {
157 var labels = []

165 function urlToLocalPath(urlValue) {
166 var raw = String(urlValue)
167 if (raw.indexOf("file://") === 0) {
168 return decodeURIComponent(raw.substring(7))
169 }
170 return decodeURIComponent(raw)
171 }
172
173 function ensurePngExtension(pathValue) {
174 var p = String(pathValue).trim()
175 if (p === "") {
176 return ""
177 }
178 if (!p.toLowerCase().endsWith(".png")) {
179 p = p + ".png"
180 }
181 return p
182 }
183
184 function localPathToFileUrl(pathValue) {
185 var p = String(pathValue || "").trim()
186 if (p === "") {
187 return ""
188 }
189 if (p.indexOf("file://") === 0) {
190 return p
191 }
192 return "file://" + p
193 }
194
195 function loadSelectedCsvFiles(files) {
196 var paths = []
197 for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
198 var path = urlToLocalPath(files[i])
199 if (path !== "") {
200 paths.push(path)
201 }
202 }
203 if (dashboard && paths.length > 0) {
204 dashboard.loadLogFiles(paths)
205 exportHint.text = ""
206 }
207 }
208
209 function exportChartsAsPng(targetPath) {
210 var safePath = ensurePngExtension(targetPath)
211 if (safePath === "") {
212 exportHint.text = "Ruta de exportación vacía"
213 return
214 }
215
216 exportHint.text = "Exportando PNG..."
217 captureArea.grabToImage(function(result) {
218 var ok = result.saveToFile(safePath)
219 if (ok) {
220 exportHint.text = "PNG exportado: " + safePath
221 } else {
222 exportHint.text = "No se pudo exportar PNG"
223 }
224 })
225 }
